_comment: Rows of ../util.json that pin a defect of the current code on purpose (known_bug: the catalog id in tests/README.md), moved here unchanged: the same groups and the same row format, which the comment of that file describes. A port does not have to reproduce any of them.

deepArrayEqual.name: nested arrays with equal content are not equal
deepArrayEqual.note: Elements are compared with ===, so equal-looking nested arrays differ. Name says deep, behavior is shallow. Never hit in production: all statuses are flat integer arrays.

deepArrayEqual.name: objects with equal content are not equal

getJsValue.name: getjsvalue-evals-content: arithmetic in the match is computed, not parsed as a literal
getJsValue.note: The matched text is executed as JavaScript (vm), not parsed as a literal. A port should parse array/number/string literals only.

iterateTuples.name: 2 pairs (4 items) yield only 1
iterateTuples.note: A correct version yields all 2 pairs.

iterateTuples.name: 3 pairs (6 items) yield only 2
iterateTuples.note: A correct version yields all 3 pairs.

iterateTuples.name: 4 pairs (8 items) yield only 2
iterateTuples.note: A correct version yields all 4 pairs.

iterateTuples.name: captured index page: 32 zone slots yield only 16 pairs, which still include all six enabled zones
iterateTuples.note: The slots after the 16th are all disabled on this panel, so the data loss only shows with more than 16 zones. A correct version yields all 32 pairs.
